name: PGC 1021091 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 1021091, an early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc1021091-hubble
story: An early-type galaxy with the catalog type S0-a. Hubble looked here while hunting for black holes that are oversized for their small hosts.

claims.text: Hubble program 13050 'The Most Massive Black Holes in Small Galaxies' imaged PGC1021091 to hunt for overmassive black holes in compact early-type galaxies
PGC 1021091 has visual morphology S0-a; Siena Galaxy Atlas ID 872949
